segments.text: My son, if you receive my words and you treasure my commandments within you,

verses.text: to make your ear attentive to wisdom, you incline your heart to understanding.

verses.text: For YHWH gives wisdom; from His mouth [is] knowledge and understanding.

verses.text: He stores up for the upright good sense—protection for those walking with integrity.

verses.text: He watches over the paths of justice, and the way of His holy ones He guards.

verses.text: Then you will understand righteousness and justice and uprightness, every good path.

verses.text: For wisdom will enter into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

segments.text: Discretion will guard over you; understanding will guard you,
